purpose: Compile the first truthful DomainSpec v2 backend and clean frontend graph for Essays while preserving DomainSpec release admission as a separate authority decision.
semantic_limits: Whisper remains a candidate Agent Capability realization and is not collapsed into the Essays Product Capability or system ontology.
Milkdown remains a replaceable editor-adapter candidate and owns no product or domain state.
The profile admits only relationships already active in the current DomainSpec v2 relationship registry.
The compiled graph is development evidence and does not change DomainSpec authority or grant release admission.
